additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only the String type is supported.

Key-value pair representing a defined tag key and value, scoped to a namespace.

Example: `{"CostCenter": "42"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a
namespace. For more information, see [Resource Tags](/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Operations": {"CostCenter": "42"}}`

displayName.description: A user-friendly name. Does not have to be unique, and it's changeable. Avoid entering confidential information.

freeformTags.description:
Free-form tags for this resource. Each tag is a simple key-value pair with no
predefined name, type, or namespace. For more information, see [Resource Tags](/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Department": "Finance"}`

isEnabled.description: Whether the autoscaling configuration is enabled.
